Title: Tanay's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Tanay - 12 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Shalini - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Zoya - 11 years, friend
Look: glasses, blue dress
4. Vihaan - 10 years, friend
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Shalini stands near him.]

Tanay: "Let's do something fun today."

[It starts to rain.]

Shalini (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[A light drizzle begins.]

Tanay (surprised): "What happened?"

[A strong wind starts blowing.]

Shalini (excited): "How beautiful!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Tanay (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
